question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date))
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) = 25;

  )

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_year
    -- Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    - CASE
        WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
        WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '24' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate exact age: customer must have turned 25 on or before 2026-09-25, but not yet 26
    -- Age = 25 means: birth_date + 25 years <= 2026-09-25 < birth_date + 26 years
    -- Using SQLite date functions: julianday() for comparison
    julianday('2026-09-25') - julianday(c.birth_date) >= 25 * 365.25
    AND julianday('2026-09-25') - julianday(c.birth_date) < 26 * 365.25
    -- More precise: check if the 25th anniversary is on or before reference date, and 26th is after
    AND (
        -- 25th anniversary: birth_date + 25 years
        -- We need to check if this date is <= 2026-09-25
        -- Using strftime to construct the anniversary date
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') <= '2026-09-25'
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years') > '2026-09-25'
    );

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate exact age on 2026-09-24
    -- A customer is exactly 25 years old if their 25th birthday is on or before 2026-09-24
    -- and their 26th birthday is after 2026-09-24
    -- This means: birth_date + 25 years <= 2026-09-24 AND birth_date + 26 years > 2026-09-24
    -- Using SQLite date functions with text dates
    (c.birth_date || ' 00:00:00') <= '2026-09-24 00:00:00'
    AND (c.birth_date || ' 00:00:00') > '2026-09-24 00:00:00'
    AND 
    -- 25th anniversary (birth_date + 25 years) <= 2026-09-24
    (strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 25) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) || ' 00:00:00' <= '2026-09-24 00:00:00'
    AND
    -- 26th anniversary (birth_date + 26 years) > 2026-09-24
    (strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 26) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) || ' 00:00:00' > '2026-09-24 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
    OR (
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
      AND (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) < 9
        OR (
          CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
          AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 25
        )
      )
    )
  )
  AND NOT (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
    AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 9
    AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND 0 = 0 -- This condition is never true, but ensures the logic is correct for "exactly 25 years old"
  );
